name: MyStoreGuardian Connector
author: MyStoreGuardian

sections.description:
Is your store actually working right now?

Most store owners don’t know their checkout is broken until a customer complains. By then, you have already lost sales.

The MyStoreGuardian Connector links your WooCommerce store to our automated monitoring service. We act as a “Mystery Shopper,” visiting your site continuously to test:

  • Product Pages: ensuring “Add to Cart” buttons are visible and working.
  • Checkout Flow: Simulating a user journey to catch glitches.
  • Inventory Sync: Alerting you if items are wrongly marked as out-of-stock.

How it works:
1. Install this plugin.
2. Click “MyStoreGuardian” in your left WordPress admin menu (or find the dashboard widget).
3. Click the blue “Start for free” button to sign up for an account on the MyStoreGuardian website.
4. After signing up successfully, you can log in to the MyStoreGuardian dashboard.
5. From the MyStoreGuardian dashboard, you can use the “Manual Tester” to immediately verify your WooCommerce product pages.
6. To enable 24/7 automated monitoring, configure your store’s product URLs in the “Monitor Settings” page.

Note: This plugin connects your site to the MyStoreGuardian SaaS platform. Clicking the “Start for free” button will securely pass your email and store URL to our website to streamline your free account registration.

Service Disclosure

This plugin relies on MyStoreGuardian, a third-party service, to monitor your store’s checkout functionality.

  • Service: MyStoreGuardian (https://mystoreguardian.com)
  • Terms of Service: https://mystoreguardian.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://mystoreguardian.com/privacy

Upon clicking the “Start for free” button, your store URL and admin email address are securely passed to MyStoreGuardian to pre-fill your registration form. After signing up successfully, you can log in and use the monitoring dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mystoreguardian-connector folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Click “MyStoreGuardian” in your left WordPress admin menu, or look for the “MyStoreGuardian Status” widget on your main Dashboard.
  4. Click the blue “Start for free” button.
